ria: Quick heads-up — need 2x LGTM on PR 8321 (kv-cache OOM mitigation) before today's 15:30 cutoff, ~25m from now. CI is green, smoke passed on canary. @ben can you give a quick second look?
ben: On it, looking through now. leaving small comment on concurrency guard.
ria: Thanks — most changes are in `runtime/kv_warmup.go` and a small db migration. Tests added: `TestKVWarmupConcurrency`.
sam: Can also eyeball. If it's a small guard and CI is green, happy to sign off after Ben's comment resolved.
ben: comment addressed. changed locking to use RWMutex instead of atomic. Verified locally `make smoke` passed.
monica: quick question — migration is backward compatible? I skimmed the migration file.
ria: yes, it's additive; old nodes ignore new column. Migration wraps in txn with idempotent check. Included migration check in smoke.
monica: ok +1 from me, looks safe.
sam: +1. Ben already updated. Go for merge unless anyone has objections.
deploy-bot: Deploy window opens in 20m; tagging PR 8321 for merge; reminder: ensure `canary=false` toggle is set for this hotfix.
ria: merging now. thanks all :tada:
ben: :thumbsup:
monica: nice work.
sam: thanks. keep an eye on latency after rollout.
